status: All 837 previously evaluated SciFact claims are exploratory development data. No subset of these claims is an untouched confirmation set.
weighting: Each claim has equal training weight. Where both pools exist their total weights are equal. Outcomes and source identifiers never enter predictor features.
selection: Equal mean of controlled-pool and natural-pool precision at 100 admitted sentences per 100 claims. Maximum eligible rank five. Source-connected claim groups stay in the same fold.
candidate_family: Raw full and isolated rationale, raw full product; arithmetic and power-mean fusion; nonnegative logistic fusion; monotone gradient boosting of full, isolated, dual and dual plus context. Each learned single-context control receives the same optimization and model capacity as the corresponding dual model.
stopping: One smoke run, one complete grouped development run. External test outcomes remain unopened until model and controls are frozen. Any later trial gets a new recorded protocol and remains exploratory.
confirmation: Untouched public HealthVer and CovidFact official test splits, evaluated after development freeze. Scores may be computed without reading annotations. Report each dataset and all declared controls.
uncertainty: Source-family paired bootstrap with budget reallocation. Simultaneous intervals for the prespecified primary comparisons.
smoke_gate: Finite predictions, row and outcome invariance, exact admission counts, valid source groups. Continue a family only when the smoke comparison shows useful performance.
